description: Though headless and limbless, this torso sculpture holds an astonishing expressive power. The delicately carved drapery clings to the form beneath it, as if frozen in a fleeting moment of motion. name: Realistic Rigged Procedural Eye
description:
Fully procedural eye, rigged with shape keys for a variety of pupil shapes and dilation range. All texture attributes are easily editable in the material properties, including iris, sclera, limbus, blood vessel and pupil colour.

Also casts refractive caustics through the cornea (a light source object must be assigned in the material properties; location and rotation dependent and other lighting still has influence, including HDRI) and uses parallax occlusion mapping for the iris.
author: Joshua Jennings
